title: Layer 3: Fork independence proof
description: Write structural proof of fork independence (safety property 6). Required reading: docs/plans/21-agent-tlaplus-spec.md (section 5.1 Layer 3). This is a proof sketch, not a TLC model. Verify Clone() creates fresh objects with no shared mutable pointers. Document in specs/agent_loop_fork_proof.md or as a comment block in the TLA+ spec. Depends on Layer 1 for context but can be done in parallel.
